team.name: James Ray
team.bio:
James Ray is a marine conservationist and researcher based in the Maldives, currently working with Reefscapers on coral reef restoration, marine conservation and cetacean research. He holds a BSc (Hons) in Earth and Ocean Science and is a JNCC-qualified Marine Mammal Observer. His previous experience includes working with Blue Planet Marine on the Crown-of-Thorns Starfish Control Programme. He is also a professional photographer, freediving instructor and Divemaster, combining scientific knowledge with practical experience in marine environments.

As Co-Founder of Koamas, James is passionate about advancing cetacean research and conservation through citizen science, individual photo-identification and collaborative research. He aims to help build a long-term, locally driven platform connecting researchers, institutions and communities to improve our understanding and protection of whales and dolphins across the Maldives and, ultimately, the wider Indian Ocean.
